content: Greed destroys every noble virtue, as an untamed forest fire consumes dry grass.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
explanation: A person may possess brilliant scholarship, sharp wit, and refined manners. But if the demon of greed takes root in their heart, truth will be sold, friendship will be betrayed, and integrity will be bargained away. Uproot craving before it scorches your forest.
practicalInsight: Celebrate someone else's financial gain or promotion today without feeling a single pang of envy or wanting a piece.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your financial or professional life is healthy ambition crossing the line into toxic greed?
